content: Hello, I am Alder Credit's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Reese Park?
Yes, this is Reese Park. I'm on a short break, so I've got a few minutes. What do you need from me?
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your postcode?
AB07 is all I can give you there, sorry. I'm not sure about anything beyond that.
I'm sorry, that's not correct. Could you please tell me your postcode?
I've already given it: my postcode is AB07. If that doesn't match, I can give you my birth year instead.
And what is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
I can't do it today, but I can pay the full 900 pounds tomorrow, October fifteenth. Would that work?
I am sorry, I do not have that information. To confirm: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm: 900 pounds on the credit card on Thursday, 15 October.
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. A letter confirming the promise will be sent. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thanks. I need to get back to work now. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
